assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide landscape photograph for premium travel companion journey card. Primary request: Munnar, Kerala emerald tea plantations with layered Western Ghats at warm dawn and atmospheric mist. Scene/backdrop: authentic undulating tea fields on steep hillsides, distant blue-green mountain ridgelines, delicate valley mist, warm peach dawn sky. Style/medium: premium travel editorial photography, realistic natural texture, cinematic but understated color, no oversaturation. Constraints: image only, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no people, no buildings.
